notes.subject: ho Yahwe
notes.rationale: Sesotho e hloka polelo e hlakileng; Hebrew ha e bolele Lebitso mona

notes.subject: Na…?
notes.rationale: Hebrew ha e na le letshwao la potso; boemo bo bontsha potso e retolohileng

notes.subject: habohla
notes.rationale: זבח e bolela bohla/sembeko, eseng feela 'ntha e kholo'

notes.subject: potso
notes.rationale: Baruteliwa a hanahana: potso e letetsoeng karabo e 'Ee' kapa 'Tjhe' — Septuaginta e eketsa karabo 'Tjhe'

notes.subject: ho Yisraele
notes.rationale: Puo e bitsetsa ntlo ya Yisraele ka boomo

translation: Na ⟨habohla⟩ le minkha le fihlisa ho ‹Yahwe› ka ntlha ya ka bohaleng bohle ba mashome a mane, ntlo ya Yisraele?
